require "active_support"
require "active_support/message_encryptor"
require "base64"

module StringEncryption
  class << self
    def initialize_encryptor
      key = fetch_encryption_key
      ActiveSupport::MessageEncryptor.new(key)
    end

    def encrypt(data)
      raise ArgumentError, "Data cannot be nil" if data.nil?

      encryptor = initialize_encryptor
      encrypted_data = encryptor.encrypt_and_sign(data)

      encrypted_data
    end

    def decrypt(encrypted_data)
      raise ArgumentError, "Encrypted data cannot be nil" if encrypted_data.nil?

      begin
        encryptor = initialize_encryptor
        encryptor.decrypt_and_verify(encrypted_data)
      rescue ActiveSupport::MessageVerifier::InvalidSignature
        raise DecryptionError, "Invalid signature - data may have been tampered with"
      rescue ActiveSupport::MessageEncryptor::InvalidMessage
        raise DecryptionError, "Could not decrypt data - invalid message"
      rescue ArgumentError => e
        raise DecryptionError, "Invalid key format: #{e.message}"
      end
    end

    private
      def fetch_encryption_key
        encoded_key = ENV["ENCRYPTION_KEY"]
        raise ConfigurationError, "ENCRYPTION_KEY environment variable is not set" if encoded_key.nil?

        begin
          Base64.strict_decode64(encoded_key)
        rescue ArgumentError
          raise ConfigurationError, "ENCRYPTION_KEY environment variable is not valid Base64"
        end
      end
  end

  class DecryptionError < StandardError; end
  class ConfigurationError < StandardError; end
end
